description: gRPC over h2c on the zix.Grpc engine built on zix.Http2, .EPOLL dispatch: each worker owns its SO_REUSEPORT listener, epoll set, and connections, with no shared state across cores. Replies use comptime-cached HPACK blocks. Implements GetSum (unary) and StreamSum (server-streaming). No response cache: the reply is a few bytes, so a lookup would cost more than the add.
